subnet_v4_prefix.description: Aggregate POSTs per IPv4 subnet of this prefix (e.g. 24) and ban the whole subnet; 0 = off (default). Allowed: 0 or 16..32.

subnet_v6_prefix.description: Same for IPv6 (e.g. 64); 0 = off (default). Allowed: 0 or 48..128.

subnet_threshold.description: POSTs from one subnet within window_secs that trigger a subnet ban; 0 disables subnet aggregation. Default 20.

subnet_min_distinct_ips.description: Distinct source addresses required in the subnet before it fires. Default 5.
